question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A perfect society in which people work well with each other and are happy
solution:
The correct answer is **"Utopia."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Utopia"** is a one-word substitute for a perfect society in which people work well with each other and are happy. (कल्‍पनालोक (कल्‍पना में बना संसार जहाँ सब कुछ आदर्श स्थिति में है), आदर्श-लोक, रामराज्‍य)

 
 
• **Example**: *Try and imagine a perfect society, a **utopia**__, in which the government really got everything right.*
 
 
 
• It is a noun and pronounced as **"yoo-toh-pee-uh".**
 
• The term **"utopia" **is often used to describe an ideal society or community that is impossible to achieve in reality.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Gala land) **means a special public occasion at which there is a lot of entertainment, usually in the form of different types of performances. (एक विशेष सार्वजनिक अवसर जिस पर ढेर सारा मनोरंजन होता है, आमतौर पर विभिन्न प्रकार के प्रदर्शनों के रूप में)
 
• **Option 2 (Dystopia)** is the opposite of Utopia and refers to an imaginary society where everything is bad or unpleasant. (एक काल्पनिक समाज जहाँ सब कुछ बुरा या अप्रिय है)
 
• **Option 3 (Homeland)** is a noun that refers to a person's country of birth or the place where they feel they belong. (स्‍वदेश, मातृभूमि)
